issues: The reversal is triggered by Reverse Transaction on a G/L transaction. Nothing given says FA transactions are reversed on their own.
Only the reversing FA ledger entry's Total CO2e is negated, so the fixed asset's Acquisition Total CO2e nets to zero. The acquisition total itself is not negated.

The page calls the G/L posting event new. The existing OnCodeOnAfterStartOrContinuePosting event only gained a NextTransactionNo parameter. The new event is OnInsertReverseEntryOnBeforeInsertFALedgEntry in FA Insert Ledger Entry.
